paragraphs.heading: Site boundary
paragraphs.text: The Site comprises Parcels 9, 10 and 11 at Bracken Farm, Wickham, as shown edged red on Drawing SP-01.

paragraphs.heading: Export cable route
paragraphs.text: The export cable shall run from the Site to Wickham Primary Substation across Parcels 14 and 15, as shown dashed blue on Drawing SP-02.

paragraphs.heading: Parcel ownership
paragraphs.text: Parcel 14 is owned by Mr R. Keane of Fen Lane Farm. Parcel 15 is owned by Wickham Estates Limited.

paragraphs.heading: Drawings
paragraphs.text: Drawing SP-01: Site boundary, revision C.
